title: Utawarerumono The False Faces
native: うたわれるもの 偽りの仮面
synopsis:
When I came to, I realized I was standing in the middle of a vast, snowy plain I knew nothing of. I didn't know how I got there. And to add to that, I couldn't remember anything, not even my name. I stood there, dumbfounded at my absurd situation. But then, as if to spite me further, a gigantic monster suddenly appeared, an insect-like creature that began to bear down on me. I tried desperately to run, but it cornered me into a hopeless situation. It was then that the girl appeared. Her name was Kuon. It was this beautiful girl, who bore an animal's ears and tail, who saved my life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Curse
episodes.synopsis: A man wakes up on a snowy mountain with no memories, where he is chased by a giant centipede monster. He's saved by a girl with furry ears and a long cat tale.

episodes.title: The Righteous Man
episodes.synopsis: The village is under attack by monsters called gigiri, small insects with nasty claws. Haku and Kuon go with a group of mercenaries to help wipe them out, but get more than they bargained for when they run into a boro-gigiri, a monster that's over 30 feet tall.

episodes.title: The Road to the Capital
episodes.synopsis: Haku and Kuon travel to the capital, but their journey is interrupted by a bandit attack.

episodes.title: The Imperial Capital
episodes.synopsis: Having reached the capital, Haku and gang look for work... but not before partying. That's when a girl named Nekone appears before them, and she's actually Ukon's little sister.

episodes.title: The Pirate Girl
episodes.synopsis: Haku's busy days of working hard in the mornings and afternoon and studying at night are wearing down his mind. However, his hard work pays off when he's finally given a vacation. With his freedom and a little money, he sets out to the capital.

episodes.title: The Master of the Inn
episodes.synopsis: The inn where Haku's staying, the Hakuroukaku, is known for its beautiful owner. She sends him a letter and invites him to a banquet. He goes, but...

episodes.title: The Young Princess
episodes.synopsis: The emperor of Yamato holds absolute loyalty from his subjects. And his daughter, Anju, has her birthday approaching. Hakuroukaku finds itself with a strange visitor. Kuon's eyes shine coldly at this selfish young girl.

episodes.title: Imperial Capital Detective Stories
episodes.synopsis: A lone passenger ship set sail in the night fog. It turns out to be a hub for illegal gambling.

episodes.title: Messengers from the Land Where Gods Sleep
episodes.synopsis: A messenger arrives at Yamato, claiming he's from a land beyond the eastern sea.

episodes.title: In Love
episodes.synopsis: Anju is in love with Oshutoru, the royal general. But because she is the imperial princess, she can't fall in love like ordinary people do. Kuon and the others try their best to help her.

episodes.title: The Princess Plays with Fire
episodes.synopsis: The princess has decided to pretend to be kidnapped, in hopes that Oshutoru will come and save her. She enlists Nosuri's help and Haku is forced to help too. But Nosuri has no idea who she really is, and when Oshutoru comes, Haku is forced to face him alone...!

episodes.title: Kamunagi of Chains
episodes.synopsis: For his services in saving the princess, Haku is invited to the palace and given an audience with the emperor. He is gifted two girls who are called the Priestesses of Chains. But he doesn't realize the deep meaning they possess.

episodes.title: The Eight Pillar Generals
episodes.synopsis: Yamato is threatened by a barbarian invasion from the north, but the town doesn't seem worried at all. The eight pillar generals mount a counterattack, and Haku finds himself dragged along.

episodes.title: Blade Master
episodes.synopsis: The invading forces are taking Yamato citizens hostage and using them as front line troops against the Eight Pillar generals. Rurutie and Haku go on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines to release the hostages' loved ones.

episodes.title: Masks
episodes.synopsis: The ancient power of the masks is brought down to bear on the invading Usuurussha armies. The armies are torn apart by the power of the Eight Pillar Generals, but is the cost to Yamato's own citizens too great?

episodes.title: Banquet
episodes.synopsis: After returning from the war, Haku is deeply depressed. The girls all offer him gifts to cheer him up, but it doesn't help. So all the men decide to have a massive banquet and drink together. It gets out of hand and everyone starts taking off their clothes...

episodes.title: Afterglow
episodes.synopsis: The truth behind Haku's past is revealed. What is his connection to the emperor, and to the mysterious and powerful masks?

episodes.title: Invasion
episodes.synopsis: The Emperor has declared war on Tousukuru, and Haku is summoned to join the fight. Will Kuon be willing to fight against her homeland?

episodes.title: In Flames
episodes.synopsis: The war against Tousukuru is going poorly, and Haku is sent with reinforcements. Munechika turns to him to come up with a plan to break the stalemate.
